name.en: Lumbricaria thread like coprolite form study

description.en: Stylized Lumbricaria trace morphology informed by directly inspected PRI76858 specimen thumbnail and its collection description. Jurassic refers to Solnhofen Limestone, Germany, for that specimen only. Slab size and geometry, original tangle path, crossings, colors and enhanced relief are artistic; precise producer, behavior and relief polarity uncertain. Not an animal species or exact specimen replica; no imported photographic texture or mesh.
